lock_status: Amended after development-only smoke tests; validation and test splits were not inspected when this version was written
phase_space: R^2; standard two-form dx wedge dy at rho=1; conformally symplectic for 0<rho<1; singular at rho=0

primary_parameter.provenance: Inherited post-critically finite Logistic parameter; frozen before inspecting orbit multipliers, prime labels, or Riemann zeros
primary_parameter.interpretation: attributed arithmetic seed, not an established prime-sieve isomorphism

positive_control_parameter.purpose: binary-horseshoe periodic-orbit enumeration control; never an arithmetic control

legacy_control_parameter.status: tainted negative control because earlier work used target-oriented heuristics

primary_observable.name: left-return parity polarity
primary_observable.symbolization: L iff x<0 and R otherwise
primary_observable.gap_definition: iteration difference between consecutive L visits before escape
primary_observable.parent_prediction: P=1 for the inherited mod-2 shadow
primary_observable.availability_gate: finite exposure fraction >=0.80 and at least 10000 return gaps
primary_observable.confirmatory_pass_rule: At rho=1, the cluster-bootstrap 95% lower bound for P is at least 0.98, the availability gate passes, and u_c is significantly more specific than every neighbor-a control after Holm correction
primary_observable.failure_interpretation: Failure is A0-shadow failure or carrier unavailability, not evidence about Riemann zeros

trajectory_protocol.initialization: For each split, PCG64 draws x_{-burn} uniformly in [-1,1]; burn the rho=0 parent map, then initialize (x_0,x_-1) from consecutive parent states
trajectory_protocol.exposure_fraction: number of finite pre-escape iterates divided by ensemble_size*horizon
trajectory_protocol.test_access_rule: The test split may be executed only after code, thresholds, and plots are frozen and validation results are recorded

periodic_orbit_protocol.completeness_rule: Exact binary-necklace counts are required at a=6; no completeness claim is allowed at a=u_c without validated root isolation
periodic_orbit_protocol.continuation_rule: rho=0 is a singular endpoint. Branch continuation starts at rho>0 and must report Jacobian singular values and branch collisions; code agreement is not orbit identity after a bifurcation

orbit_clock: ell_gamma=log(abs(Lambda_u,gamma)) for primitive hyperbolic orbits; iteration period is always reported separately
normalization: No fitted scale, phase, unfolding, orbit reordering, or post-hoc assignment is allowed
determinant_convention: No dynamical determinant is evaluated in Stage 1. The unstable-multiplier Ruelle product and the Gutzwiller stability denominator remain distinct deferred objects.
arithmetic_origin: Unverified inherited Logistic symbolic seed; repository evidence supports at most a parity/mod-2 shadow and includes known kneading defects
allowed_data_during_candidate_constructi: generic Markov, shuffle, neighbor-parameter, and high-a controls
forbidden_data: parameters tuned to make multipliers close to integers or primes
von Mangoldt weights inserted into the dynamics
stop_rules: If the a=6 orbit finder misses the exact binary-necklace count, repair the ledger before interpreting a=u_c.
If the rho=1 availability gate fails, classify the arithmetic carrier as unavailable and do not condition only on rare survivors.
If neighbor parameters or temporal nulls reproduce the parity effect, classify it as nonspecific (PROVES_TOO_MUCH).
If branch identity is lost at a singular Jacobian or bifurcation, stop calling the endpoints the same orbit.
Do not inspect primes, construct a Riemann-targeted zeta, or quantize the map after A0-shadow failure.
